# Where a marker can be written

The placement marker is an empty top-level div and nothing else. This document
writes the class in three places that cannot place an index — a heading, an
inline span and a fenced code block — and puts a nested marker alone inside two
containers of different kinds. Each misuse is reported, nothing an author wrote
is deleted, and the index still lands at the one real marker below.

One term is marked here: [delta]{.index}.

## A heading carrying the class {.qi-index-here}

A heading is not a div, so this places nothing. The heading itself is left
exactly as written — the extension reports the mistake rather than editing an
element the author wrote.

An inline span carrying the class, [right here]{.qi-index-here}, places nothing
either, and likewise survives with its class.

``` {.qi-index-here}
A fenced code block carrying the class places nothing.
```

# Containers emptied by a nested marker

A marker below the top level places nothing. Where it is the only thing in its
container, removing it leaves that container empty, which is reported as well —
the container is kept, since nothing the author wrote is deleted.

::: {#emptied-div .surrounding}
::: {.qi-index-here}
:::
:::

> ::: {.qi-index-here}
> :::

# The marker that counts

The one real marker follows. Another term is marked here: [epsilon]{.index}.

::: {.qi-index-here}
:::

# After the marker

Text after the marker, so the index's position is provable rather than merely
last.
